purpose: Segment-based field for direct date or date-time entry.

notes: VeliProvider supplies the React Aria locale used to format and order date segments.

useWhen: Users should enter a date directly, segment by segment.
A form needs date or date-time entry without an attached calendar popover.
The value must be submitted as an ISO string through a named form field.

avoidWhen.situation: Users need visual date discovery or availability context.
avoidWhen.guidance: Use a calendar-backed picker or an embedded calendar.

avoidWhen.situation: The field should open a calendar from a compact trigger.

supportedInteractions: Edit date and optional time segments.
Submit a named value through a form.
Enforce minimum, maximum, required, and custom validation rules.
approvedPatterns: Provide a visible label for form use.
Use description text for entry guidance and errorMessage for invalid-state recovery.
Set granularity only when time segments are required.
Use placeholderValue to establish the segment shape and calendar or time-zone context.
limitations: No calendar or availability surface is included.
Helper description is hidden while the field is invalid.
Time-zone entry depends on the supplied date value and formatting settings.
accessibility: The visible label is associated with the React Aria date field.
Each editable date part is rendered as a semantic date segment.
Disabled fields prevent editing and focus; read-only fields keep the value readable.
Required and invalid states are exposed through the underlying field semantics.
responsive: The field fills its container; constrain its parent to the intended form width.
Allow validation and description text to wrap below the field.
rtl: Use VeliProvider for Dhivehi locale and RTL segment ordering.
The field uses locale-aware React Aria date segments.
